description: P3 consumer-assertion: CHECK 13 (P18 fail-closed shell floor) in tools/policy_check.sh is load-bearing — it lints every plugin/**/*.sh for `set -euo pipefail` (errexit/nounset/pipefail, detected independently) and PASSES only on a full floor OR a documented CHECK13 allowlist exception. This fixture pins the three load-bearing literals that prove the check exists and still enforces the floor-OR-allowlisted contract: the `=== CHECK 13:` section header (the block exists), `add_finding 'CHECK13'` (it emits CHECK13 findings), and `test_allowlisted 'CHECK13'` (the allowlist-escape path is wired through the established allowlist machinery). superset mode fails if any of the three is removed; extras from elsewhere in the file are ignored.
